purpose: Read typed current product work derived from self-owned canonical Reconciliation and explicit review-on-end Session truth.

routine.return_type: TABLE(reason_code text, subject_kind text, subject_ref uuid, title text, effective_at timestamp with time zone, reconciliation_ref uuid, outcome_ref uuid, purpose_code text, session_ref uuid, session_timing_material_state_ref uuid)

state_history.current_binding: Uses only accepted-current canonical owners plus a real bounded current Session timing state.
state_history.chronology: Schedule expiry and missing Actual never create review work by themselves.
state_history.immutability_policy: Read-only derived projection; no queue persistence or generic resolve flag.

obligations: reconciliation_open routes only to B10 Reconciliation.
realization_review requires explicit review_on_end plus a real bounded B08 Session.
A current Actual state using the exact Session/timing basis removes its realization_review item.
